Hi Chloe / Alex,

We’re excited to see Redwood’s technical preview next week. Before we can schedule the live walkthrough with our platform team and CISO, our vendor intake team needs a few items finished: an executed mutual NDA, completed vendor security questionnaire, and a filled onboarding form (we also need the SSO integration notes for our IdP team).

Could you confirm who on your side will own each item and a target date? Our CISO also has travel the week of 3/20 — if the intake isn’t closed before then, we’ll likely need to move the walkthrough to the following week.

Attachments: vendor_security_checklist.pdf (PDF: our checklist), vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx (we attached the form for reference)

Thanks,
